name: ColorHexa · #2bc091 hex color

description.zh: 先比较上方六组配色，再看下方相近颜色的变化。 查询色值、转换颜色格式并生成配色方案的网页工具，支持颜色名称、Hex、RGB 等输入。详情包含配色、相近颜色、CSS 样例和颜色模拟，官网明确工具免费；代码许可与输出商业授权未确认。
description.en: A web tool for looking up colors, converting color formats, and generating color schemes from names, Hex, RGB, and other inputs. Detail pages include schemes, nearby colors, CSS examples, and simulations. The site explicitly calls the tool free; code licensing and output commercial permissions remain unverified.
